text: Account Management: manage system accounts, including establishment, activation, modification, review, disabling, and removal.
Access Enforcement: enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.
Least Privilege: allow only authorized accesses necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.
Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users): uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users.
Identifier Management: manage system identifiers for users, devices, and services.
Authenticator Management: manage authenticators such as passwords, tokens, and certificates.
Baseline Configuration: develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system.
Configuration Settings: establish and enforce secure configuration settings for system components.
System Component Inventory: develop and maintain an inventory of system components.
Boundary Protection: monitor and control communications at external and key internal boundaries.
Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity: protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.
Protection of Information at Rest: protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.
System Monitoring: monitor the system to detect attacks, indicators of potential attacks, and unauthorized activity.
Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting: review and analyze audit records for indications of inappropriate activity.
Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning: monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and applications.
Incident Handling: implement an incident handling capability for detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
Incident Reporting: require personnel to report suspected incidents and report to relevant authorities.
System Backup: conduct backups of system-level and user-level information.
System Recovery and Reconstitution: provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state after disruption.
Literacy Training and Awareness: provide security and privacy literacy training to system users.
Physical Access Control: enforce physical access authorizations at entry and exit points to facilities.
System Security and Privacy Plans: develop and maintain security and privacy plans for the system.
